reason: The README clearly presents dsh-cron as a persistent cron scheduler that automates prompt delivery into DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with optional cold-session execution and outbound callbacks.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持时区和持久化存储的定时任务调度，并将到期提示投递到智能体会话。
summaries.en: Provides persistent, timezone-aware scheduled tasks for DeepSeek Harness and delivers due prompts to agent sessions.

capabilities: Creates and manages recurring and one-shot scheduled jobs
Persists jobs across restarts in the Harness home
Delivers scheduled prompts into live or queued agent sessions
Can resume a persisted cold session for unattended model execution when enabled
Provides a local RPC and sidebar interface for job management
Can forward settled run events to optional HTTP or macOS notification integrations
